literal.prompt: Какая компания создала консоль Xbox, впервые выпущенную в 2001 году?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The contemporary Microsoft launch announcement L15–L16 calls it the Microsoft Xbox and places the North America store launch on2001-11-15. L21–L22 explicitly says Microsoft with partners created Xbox; L70 calls Xbox Microsoft’s system. Thus Microsoft is the unique listed creator company; the prompt does not claim sole unaided authorship. Nintendo, Sega and SNK are real gaming companies, rather than joke or wrong-category alternatives. The supplied2001 qualifier identifies original Xbox and is not asked recall.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Xbox — игровая консоль компании Microsoft. Первая модель вышла в Северной Америке в ноябре 2001 года.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Sentence1 names Microsoft as Xbox’s company, directly supported by L15–L23 and L70. Sentence2 states original release in North America in November2001, a less precise but accurate version of the dated launch announcement L15–L16. Two complete Russian sentences, no unsupported exclusivity or worldwide-date claim.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Nintendo представила Game Boy в Японии в 1989 году.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The retained Nintendo history has heading1989 at L173 and Game Boy introduction in Japan at L175. The whole claim paragraph and adjacent year boundaries are visible. Note gives Nintendo’s own distinct hardware/history fact and does not assign Game Boy to Microsoft; it does not repeat questionable source superlatives about first handheld.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Sega запустила проект по созданию персонажа, который стал бы лицом компании и показывал скорость Mega Drive.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: FIX: SEGA L27 states a project to produce both a game that showcases Mega Drive’s performance (性能を強くアピールできるゲーム) and an appealing character as Sega’s face (セガの「顔」となる...キャラクター). L29 assigns unprecedented speed to the game concept/design. The note merges those goals into a character that would show the speed of Mega Drive. This is ambiguous Russian and changes the source’s specific relationship: console capabilities versus game speed versus mascot role. Preserve the useful project fact, but distinguish its game and character outputs.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: В 1990 году SNK выпустила аркадную систему MVS и домашнюю консоль AES.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: SNK About NEOGEO L124 explicitly states both systems launched in1990, identifies MVS as arcade system accepting multiple cartridges in one cabinet, and AES as home console. The note accurately preserves manufacturer/year/system types and provides a concrete fact about its own SNK option.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Первая Xbox поступила в продажу в Северной Америке 15 ноября 2001 года.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Microsoft L15–L16 dates the North American retail launch to2001-11-15. This gives region, month and day beyond prompt’s bare2001 and keyMicrosoft. It is useful new information about that company’s own console; overlap with explanation’s region/month is allowed.
